verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a built-in Organizations section where admins create and manage realm-scoped organizations (kc-supp-orgs). Realms are also documented as tenants with isolated groups of applications and users (keycloak-docs-20), so the core org/tenant modeling exists. Missing for 10: documented organization membership management, invitation flows for adding members, B2B-specific details such as org-scoped login or IdP linking, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the Organizations feature.
